## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix failed-write handling before merge because callers cannot rely on the save command’s success status.

## Changes

The pull request adds a report save command that prints the destination and a cleanup helper that tolerates an already absent temporary report. It also adds tests for saving and cleanup.

## Critical

- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Signal failed report writes — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` discards the `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns `0`. — Callers can proceed as though the report exists when the save created no file. — Fix: Report the destination and write error, return a nonzero status, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
